articles.event_key: NASA|寻求|商业航天提升哈勃轨道
articles.title: NASA征集商业方案为哈勃空间望远镜提升轨道
articles.summary: NASA就商业航天抬升哈勃轨道开放信息征询至11月30日，局长艾萨克曼称应探索创新且成本可控的在轨延寿办法；哈勃若无抬轨预计2030年代早中期再入大气层。
articles.new_facts: NASA就商业航天提升哈勃空间望远镜轨道开放信息征询，截止11月30日下午3时（美国东部时间）；哈勃若无轨道抬升预计2030年代早中期再入大气层。
articles.limitations: 仅取得The Verge对NASA征询及局长表态的转述报道，未直接获得NASA征询原文；征询属方案收集阶段，尚无选定企业、合同或实施时间表。

facts.text: 据科技媒体The Verge报道，美国航天局正向商业航天企业征集提升哈勃空间望远镜轨道的方案，信息征询开放至11月30日下午3时（美国东部时间）。

evidence.quote: NASA is taking proposals from the private sector to see if anyone can save it.
The agency will keep the Request for Information open through November 30th at 3 PM ET.

facts.text: 哈勃目前没有立即再入大气的危险，但轨道持续衰减，若不实施抬轨，预计在2030年代早中期坠入大气层。

evidence.quote: Hubble is in no immediate danger of burning up in the Earth’s atmosphere, but its time will run out in the early to mid 2030s unless its orbit is boosted.

facts.text: 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼表示，哈勃仍有重要科学任务，若存在创新且成本可控的在轨延寿办法，应当去探索，以尽可能延长其服役时间。此次征询属于方案收集，尚未进入合同或实施阶段。

evidence.quote: Hubble still has important science ahead of it, and we should be looking at every reasonable opportunity to keep it delivering for as long as possible
If there are innovative and cost-effective ways to extend the life of an asset already on orbit, we owe it to the American taxpayer and the scientific community to explore them.

bilingual.title_en: NASA Seeks Commercial Proposals to Boost Hubble Space Telescope's Orbit

sentences.en: According to tech media outlet The Verge, NASA is soliciting proposals from commercial space companies to raise the orbit of the Hubble Space Telescope, with the request for information open until 3 p.m. Eastern Time on November 30.
sentences.zh: 据科技媒体The Verge报道，美国航天局正向商业航天企业征集提升哈勃空间望远镜轨道的方案，信息征询开放至11月30日下午3时（美国东部时间）。

sentences.en: Hubble is not currently at immediate risk of re-entering the atmosphere, but its orbit continues to decay, and without a reboost it is expected to fall into the atmosphere in the early to mid-2030s.
sentences.zh: 哈勃目前没有立即再入大气的危险，但轨道持续衰减，若不实施抬轨，预计在2030年代早中期坠入大气层。

sentences.en: Administrator Jared Isaacman said Hubble still has important science missions, and if an innovative and cost-controllable method for extending its life in orbit exists, it should be explored to extend its service life as much as possible.
sentences.zh: 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼表示，哈勃仍有重要科学任务，若存在创新且成本可控的在轨延寿办法，应当去探索，以尽可能延长其服役时间。

sentences.en: This solicitation is a call for proposals and has not yet entered the contract or implementation stage.
sentences.zh: 此次征询属于方案收集，尚未进入合同或实施阶段。
